title: Jackroad Used Watch Scraper
description: Scrape used luxury watches from Jackroad (Japan's largest pre-owned watch store).

keyword.title: Search keyword
keyword.description: Brand name or keyword to search. Examples: ROLEX, OMEGA, カルティエ

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Select product condition. 0 = New (新品), 2 = Used/Vintage (中古/ヴィンテージ). Note: classification=2 on Jackroad returns vintage/used watches.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to scrape (up to 500).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers used for scraping. Use Apify proxy or custom proxies.
